correctness.rationale: The source rational MGF is F=[(P_J(t)-t²)/P_J(0)]/[Q(t)/Q(0)] with P_J=(mn-2t)((m-1)n-t)(m(n-1)-t) and Q=(mn-3t)((m-1)n-2t)(m(n-1)-2t)((m-2)n-t)((m-1)(n-1)-t)(m(n-2)-t). At R=mn/3, split logF=log J+log(1-h), h=t²/P_J. Coefficientwise 0<=h(Rz)<=h*(z)=z²/[36(1-2z/3)(1-z/2)²], with a_p=(2/3)^p-(p+3)/(3*2^p)>=0, p a_p<=1/3, sum a_p=1/3. From c_p=p[z^p](-log(1-h*)), c_p=p a_p+sum_(k=2)^(p-2) a_k c_(p-k), induction gives c_p<=1/2. Three J numerator poles-zero pairings contribute nonnegatively and the remaining simple pole at R contributes 1/p, thus p[z^p]logJ(Rz)>=1. Defect <=1/2, implying p[z^p]logF(Rz)>=1/2, hence full lower bound for ALL p,m,n. Independent exact rational coefficient tests for 5 size pairs and orders<=50 confirmed the bound; no finite experiment used to prove infinite claim.
